title: Open channel response images in a full-screen viewer
summary: The requested image viewer is implemented in current HEAD. Channel images render as buttons with a pointer affordance and open an app-owned full-screen dialog; the image is centered and contained at natural size, with a dark opaque backdrop, corner X, backdrop click close, and Escape handling. Screenshot coverage was added. No specific Task is present in the snapshot/current task list. The root has no request object; its only reply is a provider out-of-tokens failure notice.
nextAction: None for the image-viewer ask; implementation appears complete. If the requester expects the named component to be independently reusable for video, clarify that extension separately because this implementation is specifically an image overlay.
